text:
lara_sales: FYI POC with Orion Health (orion-poc) — they reported an unexpected spike in token usage and their free credits depleted during a 15-min demo. Can someone look?

devon_eng: Account name? Any request IDs?

lara_sales: orion-poc. Customer attached a short transcript and said they ran three scripted prompts, not a continuous stream. They pasted one header: x-req-id: req_7c33e2 and x-total-tokens: 91234. They expected ~9k tokens.

sam_support: Quick check: did they call embeddings by mistake? Embeddings bill differently.

lara_sales: They say they call /v1/generate with "model":"gpt-4o-mini" from Python. No embeddings.

devon_eng: Could be a loop in their test harness or a retry storm. Any SDK version?

lara_sales: Using python SDK 0.9.4. We had a known bug in 0.9.x where failed response bodies could trigger duplicate replays when the app used urllib3 retry adapter.

sam_support: Pulling logs for req_7c33e2...

oncall-ops: Noticed a correlated burst from one IP around 2026-03-20T21:05Z with many 500s. We've seen gateway timeouts then client retries. Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-20T21:05:10Z req=req_7c33e2 status=200 tokens=91234
2026-03-20T21:05:11Z req=req_7c33e3 status=200 tokens=91234
2026-03-20T21:05:12Z req=req_7c33e4 status=200 tokens=91234
```

devon_eng: That pattern suggests duplicated successful responses with same token count. Server-side bug? Did the client reuse the same prompt and our proxy retried?

sam_support: I inspected the payloads: they all contain the same prompt but different request ids. Customer's harness retried on connection reset without deduping. The problem: in our billing pipeline we hadn't normalized on content hash for short synchronous generate calls, so each successful response was billed independently.

lara_sales: Customer is upset. They were demoing to compliance team. Offer?

sam_support: Propose: (1) temporary credit to match expected tokens (we can base on customer's reported 9k), (2) recommend python SDK 0.10.0 which includes retry guardrails, (3) file a runtime patch to de-duplicate identical synchronous generates within a 30s window if same account+payload hash.

oncall-ops: Runtime patch is low risk — we can implement server-side content-hash dedupe for small payloads. ETA ~72h including QA. We'll also add metric to detect spikes.

billing_bot: ALERT: flagged 3 duplicate usage events for orion-poc at 2026-03-20T21:05Z.

lara_sales: Customer accepted a goodwill credit equal to the expected 9k tokens and wants the engineering blurb to give to their compliance folks. Can support draft the blurb and a short step-by-step to prevent future issues?

sam_support: Drafting 4-point blurb: (1) upgrade to python SDK >=0.10.0, (2) add idempotency keys or use SDK built-in guards, (3) avoid aggressive retry adapters without idempotency, (4) contact us with request ids if you see spikes.

devon_eng: I'll open an infra ticket for the dedupe patch and link to this thread.

lara_sales: Thanks team. Please post back when patch lands so I can tell them. :pray:
